recs.stt: Ask HN: What are your favorite videos relevant to entrepreneurs or startups?
recs.x: My favorite, because it's so full of great stories, is the Chris Sacca interview with Jason Calacanis on This Week In Startups. Pt.1 [link] Pt.2 [link]

Chris Sacca's background story is little known and he talks about it at length with Jason Calacanis. The part about him losing millions while still at university is as shocking as his recovery from the setback is amazing. Check out [link]
